profile_scope: General modern Khmer descriptive consonant-onset inventory; not adjudicated specifically for the project's Phnom Penh careful-citation profile.
purpose: Trace the existing provisional onset-only hints to exact character rows in a specialist orthography reference. This registry is evidence metadata, not a pronunciation gold set or a runtime rule source.

promotion_policy.review_gate: Primary phonetic evidence and qualified target-profile review are still required before any rule is promoted.

sources.title: Richard Ishida, Khmer (Cambodian) Orthography Notes
sources.locator: Basic consonants table; individual character rows
sources.limitations: Descriptive reference with context-dependent and dialect-sensitive notes; not independent project adjudication.
